name: template
body: A project template: name (directory name, unique across slide and section templates), kind (slide|section — determined by its directory, the resolved library's `slides/` or `sections/`, never declared), description, fields, sections (accepted section templates + min/max), body rule — declared in `template.yaml` — plus a standard Go html/template layout (receives pre-rendered safe HTML and typed values; only the centrally defined helper set, v1 = `media`) and example slide. Aggregate root of templating; belongs to the template library.
